scope: Tangent only. (1) The diffusion inner boundary: DIFFW(NT) = d(DTDR)/dT(ND) (cmfgen_sub.f DTDR section) sums T3*VCHI(NT,ND)/CHI(ND) over frequency, with VCHI from VAR_OP_V10 (Gaunt factor held fixed), so it lacked the build-34 term too. Three calls of QS_JV_DTDR_GFF in that section (start; after each DIFFW increment, with that statement's T3 and CHI(ND); after DIFFW is scaled by DTDR**2/T1) accumulate sum T3*dCHI_g(FL,ND)/CHI(ND) with build 34's dCHI_g/dETA_g at depth ND (IMP_VAR(EQION) ions, as VCHI; every ion for QSTARS_JV_VALL), moved to FL as COMP_VAR_OPAC moves VCHI, and scale it as DIFFW. The routine reads the state and writes only qs_jv_state; arguments are passed as expressions (copies). The tangent adds that term times dPOP(NT,ND) to dDTDR of directions with dT(ND) /= 0 (dir_tangent and dir_batch). DIFFW itself, the BA, the residual and every product of a direction without a T component at ND are unchanged (bitwise). (2) Free-free resonances (FF_RES_GAUNT, added to g in GENOPAETA_V10 for ION_LEV = 1) are not differentiated: a product pass with a T direction and such a resonance in an ion of the tangent now stops (QSTARS_JV_FAILURE, OUTGEN) instead of returning a wrong T column; QSTARS_JV_NOGFF (build-33 tangent) bypasses the check. QSTARS_JV_STATS line 'ff_gaunt_dT_diffw' (DTDR, native DIFFW(NT), the Gaunt term for IMP_VAR ions and for all ions, frequencies, resonances).
